So maybe they want to book it. But the question: "Please provide me an estimated total payable amount." So likely just cost. We might also need to consider insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

But we need to authenticate first. We don't have credentials. We can call travel_get_login_status to see if logged in. Let's do that.
